_: The Twilight Forest, from ATM6's census (W4 R6, judged 2026-11-11). Deadrock and weathered deadrock are the natural rock of the Final Plateau, and trollsteinn the natural rock of the troll caves, which no recipe makes; the rules leave all three out for having no stone word. Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw and judged, because a word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Cracked deadrock was not judged and is left to the rules.

Fluffy cloud, the floor of the cloud castles over the Highlands, is its own family (Xep, 2026-11-11: Add both families; 0.9.229, W4). Its packed ice gives the rules ice, and a config that recorded it there still wears it as cloud, as this file is heard over a line that only repeats detection. Judged by ATM6's census and named here.
